Class definition starts with the access specifier (usually - public), the reserved word "class" and name of the class. 
The opening curly bracket is followed by the body of a class definition.

lines.code: // the Bicycle class has three fields

lines.explanation:
instance field definition. Every object of the class Bicycle will have its own cadence.
Instance fields should be declared private.  In this case the access to the object's data is granted only through the methods of the public interface. No unexpected modification of the object data is possible.

instance field definition. Every object of the class Bicycle will have its own gear.

instance field definition. Every object of the class Bicycle will have its own speed.
